note: Both sets share the same 10 core claims (airfoil family, EllipSys2D, cylinder Cl/Cd, interpolation above 48% thickness, 3D correction models, no 3D correction in WindIO/report), and both repeat the airfoil-data-source fact twice. Set A additionally captures the 30%/70% mix of fully turbulent vs. transitional polars used in the Section 6 aeroelastic simulations, an important fact B omits entirely. However, A's second ratio claim is a garbled restatement ('30% and 70%' as a single transition ratio) that duplicates and misreads the two correct ratio claims. On balance A is better: two useful correct claims gained at the cost of one bad redundant claim, while B leaves the polar-mix ratio missing.
remarks: Both sets state the airfoil-data-source fact twice (once with the EllipSys2D detail, once without) — a shared duplication pattern. Both also omit the Reynolds number range Re = 8E+6 to 18E+6, the use of AirfoilPreppy for the 360-degree polar extrapolation, and the fact that wind-tunnel data at these Re ranges are unavailable for FFA-W3. The assignment of 30% to fully turbulent and 70% to transitional polars follows the word order of 'a ratio of 30% and 70%' and is not stated explicitly.
